ServiceDown
panels.description: {{ $labels.job }} has exported no metrics for 30s. Holds 1m before firing. Runbook: Run ./fleet.sh status; read .fleet/{{ $labels.job }}.log for the exit; restart with ./fleet.sh down && ./fleet.sh up. Empty: the expression returns no series, which this rule treats as OK.

panels.title: HighErrorRate
panels.description: {{ $labels.job }} answers more than 5% of requests with 5xx. Holds 2m before firing. Runbook: Open Logs filtered to {{ $labels.job }} at level error; a 503 from the gateway names the upstream that is down. Empty: the expression returns no series, which this rule treats as OK.

panels.title: ConversionsStuckPending
panels.description: conversion-svc: {{ $values.A.Value }} PENDING conversions are past their deadline and the sweeper has not resolved them for 5m. Holds 5m before firing. Runbook: The sweeper asks ledger-svc every 10s: check ledger-svc is up and answering, then Traces for span 'sweep'. Empty: the expression returns no series, which this rule treats as OK.

panels.title: RateLimiterUnavailable
panels.description: gateway-svc refused {{ $values.A.Value }} merchant requests in the last minute because Redis did not answer. Holds 1m before firing. Runbook: docker compose ps redis; the limiter fails closed, so every merchant call is 503 until Redis answers. Empty: the expression returns no series, which this rule treats as OK.

panels.title: RateLimiterStoreDown
panels.description: gateway-svc cannot reach Redis, or no gateway reports it: merchant requests are refused with 503. Holds 1m before firing. Runbook: docker compose ps redis and docker compose logs redis; then the gateway's own log for the PING errors. Empty: the expression returns no series, which this rule treats as OK.

panels.title: LatencySLOBurn
panels.description: {{ $labels.job }} is burning its latency budget (99% under 500 ms) 14.4x too fast over 5m and 1h. Holds 2m before firing. Runbook: Open Fleet Overview, p95 by endpoint for {{ $labels.job }}, and click an exemplar to open the slowest trace. Empty: the expression returns no series, which this rule treats as OK.

targets.expr: ((1 - sum by (job) (rate(http_server_requests_milliseconds_bucket{le="500.0", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[5m])) / sum by (job) (rate(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{uri!~"/actuator.*"}[5m]))) / 0.01 > 14.4) and ((1 - sum by (job) (rate(http_server_requests_milliseconds_bucket{le="500.0", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[1h])) / sum by (job) (rate(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{uri!~"/actuator.*"}[1h]))) / 0.01 > 14.4) and sum by (job) (rate(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{uri!~"/actuator.*"}[5m])) > 0.05

panels.title: DbPoolSaturated
panels.description: {{ $labels.job }} ({{ $labels.instance }}) has threads waiting for a database connection. Holds 1m before firing. Runbook: Fleet Overview, Database pool row: active at max means slow queries or a held transaction; check Postgres. Empty: the expression returns no series, which this rule treats as OK.

panels.title: LedgerInvariantBroken
panels.description: ledger-svc broke a posting invariant ({{ $labels.code }}) {{ $values.A.Value }} times in the last 5m. Holds 0s before firing. Runbook: Logs for ledger-svc, search 'ledger invariant violated': the trace_id opens the request that broke it. Stop postings until fixed. Empty: the expression returns no series, which this rule treats as OK.

targets.expr: sum by (job, code) (   (clamp_min(ezeebit_ledger_deposits_total{outcome="refused", code=~"CURRENCY_MISMATCH|UNBALANCED_POSTING"} - ezeebit_ledger_deposits_total{outcome="refused", code=~"CURRENCY_MISMATCH|UNBALANCED_POSTING"} offset 5m, 0) or (ezeebit_ledger_deposits_total{outcome="refused", code=~"CURRENCY_MISMATCH|UNBALANCED_POSTING"} unless ezeebit_ledger_deposits_total{outcome="refused", code=~"CURRENCY_MISMATCH|UNBALANCED_POSTING"} offset 5m))   or (clamp_min(ezeebit_ledger_conversion_postings_total{outcome="refused", code=~"CURRENCY_MISMATCH|UNBALANCED_POSTING"} - ezeebit_ledger_conversion_postings_total{outcome="refused", code=~"CURRENCY_MISMATCH|UNBALANCED_POSTING"} offset 5m, 0) or (ezeebit_ledger_conversion_postings_total{outcome="refused", code=~"CURRENCY_MISMATCH|UNBALANCED_POSTING"} unless ezeebit_ledger_conversion_postings_total{outcome="refused", code=~"CURRENCY_MISMATCH|UNBALANCED_POSTING"} offset 5m)) )
